blurb: This check confirms that the legacy comsat mail-notification service is disabled in /etc/inetd.conf. Comsat is an obsolete service that inetd starts to announce incoming mail to logged-in users, and it accepts unauthenticated, unencrypted messages from the network. A failing result means the host exposes an unnecessary, unmaintained remote service that an attacker can reach to spoof notifications on user terminals or probe for a way in.
